citation.note: Wage record retention (NDCC § 34-14-04): System must retain promotion records (wage change, effective date, justification) for minimum 2 years; support Department of Labor inspection rights.
Pay frequency: Regular paydays required; semimonthly or monthly common; must be consistent and predictable (NDCC § 34-14-02).

body.deadline_description: Final pay on separation during/after promotion (NDCC § 34-14-03): If termination occurs post-promotion, ensure all wages earned at promoted rate from effective date forward are paid by next regular payday or within 15 days of separation (whichever comes first). Include unused accrued leave unless narrow forfeiture exception met (employer informed at hire, employee voluntarily resigned, met tenure/notice conditions).

citation.note: Non-compete/non-solicit review (NDCC § 9-08-06): On promotion, check if employee subject to non-compete or non-solicit.

body.rule: Non-compete/non-solicit review (NDCC § 9-08-06): On promotion, check if employee subject to non-compete or non-solicit. If non-compete, note as unenforceable and void per statute. If non-solicit exists, verify reasonableness in duration, geography, and scope; document in system.

Whistleblower protection check (NDCC § 34-01-20): If promotion follows any protected whistleblower activity (good-faith report of unlawful conduct), flag for legal review to ensure retaliation risk is mitigated.
